# exemplified by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exemplifiedBy`](gmeow-exemplifiedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplifiedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

A document whose prose EXEMPLIFIES the voice — byte-perfect, carrying [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md) (SHACL: an undigested exemplar can drift silently) and [`gmeow:hasAboutness`](gmeow-hasAboutness.md) [`gmeow:aboutnessEnacts`](../individuals/gmeow-aboutnessEnacts.md) (: it does not describe the voice, it performs it). NOT functional: several exemplifying documents coexist.
